notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Black plates with white lettering and a yellow-and-red emblem near the left; blurred ones look grey with coloured emblem.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: All coverage is low-cam: a much bigger car blur and a low view that makes roads look wide.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: A flat river valley of pastures and farmland, with tall mountains almost everywhere, especially looming to the east.

notes.subject: bollard
notes.text: Black and white cylindrical bollards with rounded tops, often with a blue attachment on the side; wedge type on guardrails.

notes.subject: street
notes.text: Green-and-white bus stop signs with a black metal border and the word LIEMOBIL on top.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Direction signs are white for small roads and blue for bigger ones, with a pointed arrowhead.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Pedestrian signs have seven stripes on an oddly tall rectangle.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Yellow-and-black striped road separators with a rounded top and a Lego-like knob.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Road signs commonly have a round grey metal border.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: A mix of traditional alpine styles and modern buildings, especially in the larger towns.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Densely built mountain slope just east of the valley, with the valley visible below to the west.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Near Ruggell a small forested ridge lies to the south; near Mauren a developed ridge lies to the north.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: In the flat area west of Balzers, with gridded roads, two rocky peaks are visible on the far side of the border.

notes.subject: street
notes.text: Red bus stop signs sometimes appear in the capital.

notes.subject: street
notes.text: Black bus stop signs sometimes appear here.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Blue street signs with a thin white border place you in the south or around Bendern; borderless blue ones are in Eschen.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Brown street signs with an old Gothic-looking font and white border are found in the capital and northern towns.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Black signs with a white border and embossed letters are found in Schaan.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The only lakes are just south of Steg, in the middle of the mountains.
